digest.component_or_area: ticket state schema and write surfaces
propositions: Add two new ticket state fields: `bridge_project` (tri-state string) and `repos` (list of strings) to track sync destination and repository membership
Both fields must be writable at create time and edit time across all three surfaces (CLI, library, MCP) with identical behavior
`bridge_project` is promote-only on edit: setting it on a bound ticket is refused with non-zero exit, but setting on an unbound ticket is allowed
The absent, explicit-empty-string, and populated states of `bridge_project` must be distinguishable after replay to avoid legacy tickets being misread as unsynced
Field values are written into CREATE event data by `create_core`, projected by reducer on CREATE and EDIT events, and seeded in `make_initial_state`
Edit-time validation consults `bindings.json` via the single existing reader to determine if ticket holds a binding; `repos` remains freely editable since it does not reach the tracker
